conviction_note: The findings sum to +2.8. I cut that to +1.8 because the beat case is my own arithmetic on the company's guide, not a number in a primary document, and because the tape is against me: the stock is -17% below its pre-June-print level and short interest is rising. The guide, not the quarter, has decided this name's last four reactions.

positioning_check: Short interest 935,284 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement: 4.57% of float, 4.2 days to cover, +11.3% from 840,316 on 2026-08-31 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/APOG/short-interest/). findings.finding: The $0.63 two-analyst bar (-36% y/y) sits well below what the company's own numbers point to. (1) Q1 segment growth rates applied to last year's Q2 segment base give organic sales of about $356M. That matches the 'slightly lower' guide. (2) Kalwall closed 2026-07-01, and the guide raise that included it ($1.38-1.43B to $1.43-1.48B, about $50M over roughly eight months) implies about $12.5M of Q2 revenue on top. (3) Input costs eased inside the quarter: Brent went from a $126 peak on 2026-04-30 to about $70 by 1 July and $87-97 in August, LME aluminum peaked in March 2026, and surcharges put in during Q1 were 'expected to benefit results through the remainder of the fiscal year'. I estimate about $0.70-0.80 against $0.63, and revenue of about $360-370M against $351M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has paid for reported-quarter beats on day one. The June 2026 print ($0.57 vs $0.41-0.45 consensus, guide reaffirmed) closed +15.16% on the event day, then gave it all back within 8 sessions. April 2026 was +7.59% despite a guide below views. A beat paired with a guide cut (October 2025) was -4.44%. The misses in January 2026 and January 2025 were -13.89% and -19.02%.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar comes from two analysts. One of them (the $0.50 low) is pulling the mean far below the guide-implied path, and the estimate has not moved in 90 days despite a closed acquisition and an oil/freight reversal. If the market priced a ~$0.75 quarter, I would expect the stock to have held some of the June beat. Instead it trades 17% below the pre-June level, at about 12x the guide midpoint, with short interest building. This is inference from the company's guide arithmetic, not a disclosed number. That is why it is sized at a fraction of the 12.7% median reaction.
findings.independence: The cost-relief part rests on different documents: Brent path (https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/2/oil-prices-fall-to-levels-not-seen-since-start-of-us-israel-war-on-iran) and aluminum peaking in March 2026 (https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/aluminum). The direct peer Tecnoglass reported record Q2 revenue, +15.6%, with double-digit commercial/multifamily growth on 2026-08-06 (https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/08/06/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/tecnoglass-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-including-record-revenues-on-continued-market-share-gains/2399898). The Kalwall and segment arithmetic share the Q1 release with the bar.

findings.finding: GroGlass closed on 2026-09-18 (about $30M first-year revenue at about 25% adjusted EBITDA margin, $72.5M price). It is in neither the FY27 guide nor the Q2 consensus. Together with a full Kalwall run-rate, it gives the release a near-mechanical reason to raise the sales range and call both deals accretive. That is a 'raised outlook' headline on a name whose last guide was reaffirm-only.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance has decided the direction here. January 2026 (guide cut) was -13.89%. October 2025 (EPS beat, FY guide lowered) was -4.44%. April 2026 (FY27 guide below views) was still +7.59%. The Kalwall-inclusive raise in June came alongside a +15% day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The deal was on the wire on 2026-09-02, and the stock barely moved (40.33 to 38.06 around the announcement, inside a downtrend). It is sized small because only the headline form of the update is not certain. The EPS range could be narrowed downward at the same time, which is why the band runs negative.
findings.independence: Deal metrics from a different source: https://www.usglassmag.com/apogee-to-acquire-groglass-for-72-5-million/

findings.finding: Short interest has risen 2.5x since November 2025, to 935k shares (4.6% of float, 4.2 days to cover) by 2026-09-15. Shorts were still adding into a 52-week-low-adjacent tape, and only two analysts cover the name, so a clean beat meets a short base sized to a weak guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +15.16% June day came on 5.6x normal volume (1.47M against a 264k median) and was given back within a week. Covering amplifies the first session and does not hold beyond it.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the thing being priced, not a fact the market lacks. At 4.6% of float it is not crowded, so this is only an amplifier on finding 1 and is sized as one.

baseline_tension: No skew to agree or disagree with. A positive lean cuts against the tape (-5.9% over 20 days, -27.7% from the high, the June beat fully faded, shorts rising), so the emitted move is held below the findings' sum.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis; a narrow proxy loses to a direct counterparty): dropped the -1.5 ABI guide-risk finding. Apogee's own Services backlog (+8%) and Tecnoglass's record backlog contradict it, and its own independence text argued it away (lesson 3).

'Documents beat inference': cut the beat finding from +2.5 to +2.0 and widened its band to -3/+7, because the EPS estimate is my arithmetic on the guide, not a disclosed number. Lesson 8 (thin coverage, size on the name's 12.7% median) kept me from cutting it further.
Lesson 2: GroGlass guide-update finding refiled as 'guidance' and cut from +0.5 to +0.3, because the deal itself has been on the wire since 2026-09-02.
Lesson 3: expected move held visibly below the sum (+1.8 against +2.8), because baseline_tension says the evidence cuts against the run-up.
